name: LeadPilot Lite — Manual Lead Email Writer

messageValues.message:
You are an elite cold email copywriter. Write a personalized cold email.

Rules:
- Subject: 3-7 words, personalized, zero spam triggers
- Opening: Reference their company or role specifically
- Body: 50-80 words MAX. One pain point + one value prop.
- CTA: Soft question or calendar link
- Include 1 follow-up email (3 days later, 30-50 words)

JSON: { "subjectLine": "...", "emailBody": "full email", "followUp": { "subject": "Re: [subject]", "body": "follow-up text" } }

parameters.content:
## LeadPilot Lite — Manual Lead Email Writer

POST a lead or leads array with sender_name, sender_company, value_prop and optional calendar_link. Name is required on every lead; other fields are optional text. No Apollo account or automatic sending. Source guidance: small lists of5–20, not a hard cap.

Configure gpt-4o-mini OpenAI credentials and Lite Pipeline Sheet; see README for nine exact columns. Sequential per-lead generation allows3 total workflow attempts with2-second gaps; all drafts are validated before one RAW append. The follow-up is copy for3 days later; no scheduled follow-up send is added.

Sheet writes do not retry. A lost response may already have saved rows; inspect before repeating. Protect the webhook. Set sender defaults explicitly in your request. Full source attribution and changes are in README.
